> but it still errors when attempting to preview the script/scene result. 1. You call `Tween.Interpolate_Property()` but this method doesn't exist in Godot 4.4.1, what you want is `Tween.tween_property()` 2. You pass the transition and the easy parameter for this method, but that not work, you need to set them using `Tween.set_trans()` and `Tween.set_ease()` 3. You don't need to call anything to make the tween start (and `Tween.start()` doesn't exist in 4.4.1) 4. And last, your variable is called `label` but you pass `Label` instead, Godot is case-sensitive so is important to pay attention
I recommend you take a look on [Tween documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_tween.html) to understand how they work, also i strongly recommend you avoid naming variables with class names as this is error prone and can lead to some bugs. You can use them in snake_case (tween) as this will not collide with the class `Tween`.
